And BoldDesk doesn't have to stand alone.
It can connect with other platforms and automate repetitive work.
For example, we've tested an integration with ClickUp.
A ticket can be pushed into ClickUp as a project task with the information carried over automatically.
The ClickUp number and link can then come back into the BoldDesk ticket, keeping the two systems connected.
That's one example, but the bigger opportunity is being able to connect the tools teams already use instead of making teams duplicate their work between systems.
There are also opportunities for automated responses, routing, assignment, document handling, and other repetitive tasks.
And every time we automate something repetitive, we're giving agents back time to work on the things that actually need a person.
